_about: The fix queue: art that was already placed in the world when the placement gate was seeded on 25 Oct 2026 (commit 14944c89), and only that. A new asset is never added here: it must pass independent review (scripts/review/gate.py, docs/review-agents.md). A queued asset may stay placed while it is redrawn, re-recorded and reviewed, and only while its entry holds: sha256 is the picture's current bytes (a queued picture that changes is refused until it is reviewed), the entry names when it was queued, why, what clears it and review_by, the date after which it is refused, and an asset an auditor failed carries the auditor's fix_list. Remove an entry when its asset passes (the gate prints an ADVISORY). 26 Oct: the scale gate added assets out of range (docs/reviews/2026-10-26-scale.md). 9 Nov (Claude A, the #439 triage): 48 Crossroads assets placed before the seed and never reviewed, which #421 or the front-gable roof build redraws, and 23 Crossroads props placed before the seed that failed the 8 Nov detail audit, each with its fix list; crossroads/ground renewed at its current bytes; woodland/ground removed (it passes). crossroads/square_puddles is not queued: it was first placed on 27 Oct, after the seed, so it needs a review like any new asset.

fix_list: Review at 9366301b (main bytes), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md. Bed frames: the top rails carry a stamped diagonal tick every ~4.5 texels that reads as twisted rope, not grain; the lower rails carry flat grey 2x2 dot nails on the dark seam with no lit pixel or rust (calibration C1 "dot nails"); no butt joints on 130-texel boards. Fix: grain as irregular 2-4 px streaks along each board, butt joints every 14-30 px with a nail head (dark, lit pixel above, sitting in the board) beside each, one of three sibling ramps per board. Seedlings are one 5x3 stamp in an exact 4x10 grid: three variants, +/-1 texel jitter. The dirt pad round the beds is closed by a straight dark outline (ground meeting ground is never outlined, eastward-edges 4.1, 5.1): drop the outline and fray the pad edge 2-3 px. Soil furrows, clods and the occlusion under the north rails pass.
